jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Company Description
Midbrains Technologies is a privately owned IT solutions company based in India, providing software development, web development, app development, and digital marketing services to clients worldwide. The organization focuses on high-quality, timely, and cost-effective offshore solutions that help businesses gain a competitive edge. Midbrains works in a flexible environment, adapting to client requirements to deliver value and satisfaction. The company emphasizes consistent quality, viewing every effort as important to achieving world-class service. Midbrains also prioritizes its team members, offering a supportive environment for skill development and rewarding career growth.
Role Description
The Software Engineer Intern role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad area. The intern will support the design, development, and testing of software and web applications, working closely with senior engineers to implement new features and fix defects. Day-to-day tasks include writing clean and efficient code, participating in code reviews, and assisting in back-end web development activities. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, documenting technical work, and learning best practices in software development and project execution. This position offers hands-on experience in a professional environment, with opportunities to grow technical skills and contribute to real client projects.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and software engineering fundamentals.
Practical experience or coursework in Software Development and Programming, with familiarity in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Java, C#, Python, JavaScript).
Knowledge of Back-End Web Development concepts, such as APIs, databases, and server-side frameworks.
Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and ability to apply them in designing and implementing solutions.
Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Ability to learn quickly, solve problems analytically, and work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
Good written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail in coding and documentation.
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and basic software development lifecycle concepts is an advantage.
